message.content: I just got off my night shift. I’m exhausted. Can you quickly check what we’re low on in the fridge and make a shopping list? I don’t want to forget the basics again.

content.text: Of course, Claire. Based on your usual inventory, we’re out of milk, eggs, and yogurt. You also have very little chicken breast left. Would you like to add any vegetables or fruits to the list?

message.content: Yes, please. Inès needs apples for school snacks. And we’re running low on olive oil too. Just stick to the essentials for tonight, I can’t think straight.

content.text: Got it. Here is the list: Milk, eggs, yogurt, chicken breast, apples, and olive oil. I’ve added it to your shared family calendar under 'Shopping' for tomorrow morning. Do you want me to set a reminder for 8 AM?

message.content: Yes, 8 AM is perfect. Thanks. Oh, and can you draft a quick text to Julien? I need to tell him I’ll be home late because of the handover and to pick up Hugo from kindergarten.

content.text: Sure. Here’s a draft: 'Hi Julien, handover is taking longer than expected. I’ll be home late. Please pick up Hugo from kindergarten. Love you.' Shall I send this now?

message.content: Yes, send it. And please mute my notifications for the next four hours. I need to sleep.

content.text: Done. The message has been sent, and your phone is in Do Not Disturb mode until 4 PM. Rest well, Claire.
